p.src: Summary

u.src: Summary
en: Summary

p.src: The lecture unfolds in a clean order. It starts with the question of whether balance and success can coexist. It answers by naming balance as a deliberate priority, then immediately tests that claim against a demanding travel career of roughly $5.5\times 10^{6}$ American miles. From there, the speaker gives the practical rule: away from home, work; at home, be home.

en: The lecture unfolds in a clean order. It starts with the question of whether balance and success can coexist. p.src: The weekly details make the rule concrete. Saturday is protected from all-day calls. Sunday night may contain a bounded preparation block of one to one and a half hours. The purpose is not leisure as an indulgence; it is presence with family, coaching children, and building relationships while the career is still being built. The final warning completes the arc: money alone is an incomplete endpoint, especially if it arrives after the relationship stock has been neglected for decades.
